hana: Heads up: one-week countdown for 'Inference Playbook' webinar. Need final X+LinkedIn assets, 2 copy variants, and SDR seed rules. Can someone take scheduling?
owen: I can schedule in Buffer. Proposed times: primer 8:40am PT, main 10:50am PT, follow-up Wed 9am PT.
mica: Ill draft 2 copy variants: metric-led and ops-hook. Need confirmed wording for the benchmark numbers (legal sign-off required).
gerald: Creative can export 1200x628 (X), 1080x1350 (LI), and a 6-slide carousel. Will add alt text. Drop link to final assets.
hana: Metrics to call out: approx 30% cost reduction and ~2x throughput at similar p99. Olivia will confirm exact phrasing.
owen: Add UTM: utm_source=social&utm_medium=x_linkedin&utm_campaign=playbook_jul2026&utm_content=primer1. Ill append to CTA short.link/playbook.
mica: Draft snippets: 
- Metric: "Approx 2x throughput at similar p99; cut inference cost ~30%. Live Tue 11am PT. Register short.link/playbook"
- Ops: "How we hit p99 SLOs while lowering unit cost. Live Tue 11am PT."
gerald: Uploaded initial banners here: https://drive.redwood/marketing/playbook_assets.zip. Alt text included.
hana: @sdr-bot please route registrants with utm_campaign=playbook_jul2026 to queue:webinar-social and tag:social_playbook.
sdr-bot: Routing set. utm_campaign=playbook_jul2026 -> queue:webinar-social, tag:social_playbook, owner_rotation:regional-sdrs.
owen: Ill queue drafts by Mon 2pm PT and mark "needs:legal". If legal clears by EOD Mon we publish Tue.
mica: Will post final copy to Buffer drafts and ping legal. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
